verse.verse_1: By oath of those who establish proper ranks.
verse.verse_2: And by oath of those who herd with a stern warning.
verse.verse_3: And by oath of the groups that read the Qur’an.
verse.verse_4: Indeed your God is surely only One.
verse.verse_5: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them – and the Lord of the sun’s rising points.
verse.verse_6: We have indeed adorned the lowest heaven with stars as ornaments.
verse.verse_7: And to protect it from every rebellious devil.
verse.verse_8: They cannot listen to the speech of those on higher elevations and they are targeted from every side.
verse.verse_9: To make them flee, and for them is a never-ending punishment.
verse.verse_10: Except one who sometimes steals a part, so a blazing flame goes after him.
verse.verse_11: Therefore ask them (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him), “Are they a stronger creation, or are other things of our creation, (the angels, the heavens etc.)?” We have indeed created them from sticky clay.
verse.verse_12: Rather you are surprised, whereas they keep mocking.
verse.verse_13: And they do not understand, when explained to.
verse.verse_14: And whenever they see a sign, they mock at it.
verse.verse_15: And they say, “This is nothing but clear magic.”
verse.verse_16: “When we are dead and have turned into dust and bones, will we certainly be raised again?”
verse.verse_19: So that is just a single jolt, thereupon they will begin staring.
verse.verse_20: And will say, “O our misfortune!” It will be said to them, “This is the Day of Justice.”
verse.verse_21: “This is the Day of Judgement, which you used to deny!”
verse.verse_22: “Gather all the unjust persons and their spouses, and all that they used to worship!” –
verse.verse_23: “Instead of Allah – and herd them to the path leading to hell.”
verse.verse_24: “And stop them – they are to be questioned.”
verse.verse_25: “What is the matter with you, that you do not help one another?”
verse.verse_26: In fact this day they have all surrendered.
verse.verse_27: And some of them inclined towards others, mutually questioning.
verse.verse_28: They said, “It is you who used to come to us from our right, in order to sway.”
verse.verse_29: They will answer, “You yourselves did not have faith!”
verse.verse_30: “And we did not have any control over you; but in fact you yourselves were rebellious.”
verse.verse_31: “So the Word of our Lord has proved true upon us; we will surely have to taste (the punishment).”
verse.verse_32: “We therefore led you astray, for we ourselves were astray!”
verse.verse_33: So this day they all are partners in the punishment.
verse.verse_34: This is how We deal with the guilty.
verse.verse_35: Indeed, when it was said to them, “There is no God except Allah”, they were haughty.
verse.verse_36: And they used to say, “Shall we forsake our Gods upon the sayings of a mad poet?”
verse.verse_37: In fact he has brought the Truth, and testified for the Noble Messengers!
verse.verse_38: “You surely have to taste the painful punishment.”
verse.verse_39: “And you will not be compensated except for your deeds.”
verse.verse_40: Except the chosen bondmen of Allah.
verse.verse_41: For them is the sustenance known to Us.
verse.verse_42: Fruits; and they will be honoured.
verse.verse_45: Cups of wine will be presented to them in rounds, from a spring flowing in front of them.
verse.verse_47: Neither does it intoxicate, nor give a headache.
verse.verse_48: And with them are those who do not set gaze upon men except their husbands, the maidens with gorgeous eyes.
verse.verse_49: As if they were eggs, safely hidden.
verse.verse_50: So one among them turns to the other, questioning. –
verse.verse_51: The speaker among them said, “I had a companion.” –
verse.verse_52: “Who used to tell me, ‘Do you believe it is true?’ –
verse.verse_53: ‘That when we are dead and have turned into dust and bones, that we will either be rewarded or punished?’”
verse.verse_54: He said (to others on the thrones), “Will you take a glimpse (into hell) below?”
verse.verse_55: He therefore looked down and saw him amidst the blazing fire.
verse.verse_56: He said, “By Allah, you had nearly ruined me!”
verse.verse_57: “And were it not for the munificence of my Lord, I too would have been seized and brought forth (captive)!”
verse.verse_58: “So are we never to die?” (The people of Paradise will ask the angels, with delight, after the announcement of everlasting life.)
verse.verse_59: “Except our earlier death, and nor will we be punished?”
verse.verse_60: “This is, most certainly, the supreme success.”
verse.verse_61: For such a reward should the workers perform.
verse.verse_62: So is this welcome better, or the tree of Zaqqum?
verse.verse_63: We have indeed made that a punishment for the unjust.
verse.verse_64: Indeed it is a tree that sprouts from the base of hell.
verse.verse_65: Its fruit like the heads of demons.
verse.verse_66: So indeed they will eat from it, and fill their bellies with it.
verse.verse_67: Then after it, indeed for them is the drink of boiling hot water.
verse.verse_68: Then surely their return is towards hell.
verse.verse_69: They had indeed found their forefathers astray.
verse.verse_70: So they hastily follow their footsteps!
verse.verse_71: And indeed before them, most of the former people went astray.
verse.verse_72: And indeed We had sent Heralds of warnings among them.
verse.verse_73: Therefore see what sort of fate befell those who were warned!
verse.verse_74: Except the chosen bondmen of Allah.
verse.verse_75: And indeed Nooh prayed to Us – so what an excellent Acceptor of Prayer We are!
verse.verse_76: And We rescued him and his household from the great calamity.
verse.verse_78: And We kept his praise among the latter generations.
verse.verse_79: Peace be upon Nooh, among the entire people.
verse.verse_80: This is how We reward the virtuous.
verse.verse_81: He is indeed one of Our high ranking, firmly believing bondmen.
verse.verse_83: And indeed Ibrahim is from his (Nooh’s) group.
verse.verse_84: When he came to his Lord, with a sound heart. (Free from falsehood).
verse.verse_85: When he said to his father (paternal uncle) and his people, “What do you worship?”
verse.verse_86: “What! You desire, through fabrication, Gods other than Allah?”
verse.verse_87: “So what do you assume regarding the Lord Of The Creation?” (That He will not punish you?)
verse.verse_88: He then shot a glance at the stars.
verse.verse_89: He then said, “I feel sick (of you)!”
verse.verse_90: And they turned their backs on him and went away. (The pagans thought he would transmit the disease).
verse.verse_91: He then sneaked upon their deities and said, “Do you not eat?”
verse.verse_92: “What is the matter with you, that you do not say anything?”
verse.verse_93: He then began striking them with his right hand, unseen by the people.
verse.verse_94: So the disbelievers came running towards him.
verse.verse_95: He said, “What! You worship what you yourselves have sculpted?”
verse.verse_96: “Whereas Allah has created you and your actions?”
verse.verse_97: They said, “Construct a building (furnace) for him, and then cast him in the blazing fire!”
verse.verse_98: So they tried to execute their evil scheme upon him – We therefore degraded them. (Allah saved him, by commanding the fire to turn cool).
verse.verse_99: And he said, “Indeed I shall go to my Lord Who will guide me.”
verse.verse_100: “My Lord! Give me a meritorious child.”
verse.verse_101: We therefore gave him the glad tidings of an intelligent son.
verse.verse_102: And when he became capable of working with him, Ibrahim said, “O my son, I dreamt that I am sacrificing you – therefore now consider what is your opinion”; he said, “O my father! Do what you are commanded! Allah willing, you will soon find me patiently enduring!”
verse.verse_103: Then (remember) when they both submitted to Allah’s command, and Ibrahim lay his son facing downwards. (The knife did not hurt Ismail)
verse.verse_104: And We called out to him, “O Ibrahim!”
verse.verse_105: “You have indeed made the dream come true”; and this is how We reward the virtuous.
verse.verse_106: Indeed this was a clear test.
verse.verse_107: And We rescued him in exchange of a great sacrifice. (The sacrifice of Ibrahim and Ismail – peace be upon them – is commemorated every year on 10, 11 and 12 Zil Haj).
verse.verse_108: And We kept his praise among the latter generations.
verse.verse_110: This is how We reward the virtuous.
verse.verse_111: He is indeed one of Our high ranking, firmly believing bondmen.
verse.verse_112: And We gave him the glad tidings of Ishaq, a Herald of the Hidden, from among those who deserve Our proximity.
verse.verse_113: And We sent blessings upon him and Ishaq; and among their descendants – some who do good deeds, and some who clearly wrong themselves.
verse.verse_114: And We indeed did a great favour to Moosa and Haroon.
verse.verse_115: And rescued them and their people from the great calamity.
verse.verse_116: And We helped them, so they were victorious.
verse.verse_117: And We bestowed the clear Book to both of them.
verse.verse_118: And guided them to the Straight Path.
verse.verse_119: And We kept their praise among the latter generations.
verse.verse_120: Peace be upon Moosa and Haroon!
verse.verse_121: This is how We reward the virtuous.
verse.verse_122: Indeed they are two of Our high ranking, firmly believing bondmen.
verse.verse_123: And indeed Ilyas is one of the Noble Messengers.
verse.verse_124: When he said to his people, “Do you not fear?”
verse.verse_125: “What! You worship Baal (an idol) and leave the Best Creator?” –
verse.verse_126: “Allah – Who is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?”
verse.verse_127: In response they denied him, so they will surely be brought forth as captives.
verse.verse_128: Except the chosen bondmen of Allah.
verse.verse_129: And We kept his praise among the latter generations.
verse.verse_131: This is how We reward the virtuous.
verse.verse_132: He is indeed one of Our high ranking, firmly believing bondmen.
verse.verse_133: And indeed Lut is one of the Noble Messengers.
verse.verse_134: When We rescued him and his entire household.
verse.verse_135: Except an old woman, who became of those who stayed behind.
verse.verse_137: And indeed you pass over them in the morning. –
verse.verse_138: And during the night; so do you not have sense?
verse.verse_139: And indeed Yunus is one of the Noble Messengers.
verse.verse_140: When he left towards the laden ship.
verse.verse_141: Then lots were drawn and he became of those who were pushed into the sea.
verse.verse_142: The fish then swallowed him and he blamed himself. (For not waiting for Allah’s command.)
verse.verse_143: And were he not one of those who praise. –
verse.verse_144: He would have remained in its belly till the day when all will be raised.
verse.verse_145: We then put him ashore on a plain, and he was sick.
verse.verse_146: And We grew a tree of gourd (as a shelter) above him.
verse.verse_147: And We sent him towards a hundred thousand people, in fact more.
verse.verse_148: So they accepted faith – We therefore gave them usage for a while.
verse.verse_149: Therefore ask them (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him), whether the daughters are for your Lord and the sons for them!
verse.verse_150: Or that have We created the angels as females, while they were present?
verse.verse_151: Pay heed! It is their slander that they say. –
verse.verse_152: That “Allah has offspring”; and indeed, surely, they are liars.
verse.verse_153: “Has he chosen daughters instead of sons?”
verse.verse_154: “What is the matter with you? What sort of a judgement you impose!”
verse.verse_156: “Or do you have some clear proof?”
verse.verse_157: “Then bring forth your Book, if you are truthful!”
verse.verse_158: And they have appointed a relationship between Him and the jinns; and indeed the jinns surely know that they will be brought forth.
verse.verse_159: Purity is to Allah from the matters they fabricate.
verse.verse_160: Except the chosen bondmen of Allah.
verse.verse_161: Therefore you and all what you worship. (The disbelievers and their deities.)
verse.verse_162: You cannot make anyone rebel against Him.
verse.verse_163: Except the one who will go into the blazing fire.
verse.verse_164: And the angels say, “Each one of us has an appointed known position.”
verse.verse_165: “And indeed we, with our wings spread, await the command.”
verse.verse_166: “And indeed we are those who say His purity.”
verse.verse_167: And indeed the disbelievers used to say, –
verse.verse_168: “If we had some advice from the earlier generations,” –
verse.verse_169: “We would certainly be the chosen bondmen of Allah.”
verse.verse_170: They therefore denied it, so they will soon come to know.
verse.verse_171: And indeed Our Word has already gone forth for Our bondmen who were sent.
verse.verse_172: That undoubtedly, only they will be helped.
verse.verse_173: And surely, only Our army will be victorious.
verse.verse_174: Therefore turn away from them for some time.
verse.verse_175: And watch them, for they will soon see.
verse.verse_176: So are they being impatient for Our punishment?
verse.verse_177: So when it does descend in their courtyards – so what an evil morning it will be for those who were warned!
verse.verse_178: And turn away from them for some time.
verse.verse_179: And wait, for they will soon see.
verse.verse_180: Purity is to your Lord, the Lord of Honour, from all what they say.
verse.verse_181: And peace is upon the Noble Messengers.
verse.verse_182: And all praise is to Allah, the Lord Of The Creation.
